reasoning: The clarification (spec.md, «Уточнения» 2026-09-15) keeps AC3's stated goal: the owner fallback is disabled, and saving rows or cells, including on a document without a responsible, does not assign anyone. It exempts only an explicit change of the responsible chosen inside config.

The literal reading would regress explicit, pre-existing UX. Spot check: disinfectant, audit-plan, equipment-calibration, training-plan and sanitation-day document clients set responsibleEmployeeId/approveEmployeeId/defaultResponsibleUserId inside config and PATCH without a top-level responsibleUserId. At a42eb11c, disinfectant-document-client.tsx:1226 already sent only `{ title, config }`, and the server of that time always copied the config choice to the document.

The exemption is narrow and safe: pickChangedConfigResponsible compares the previous and next config under the org roster (ORG_ROSTER_WHERE), so ids of other organizations, ROOT or archived users never qualify (probe P9).
